input.quote: HDI agrees that it shall promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than it promotes HDI's
input.rationale: The only "no less favourable" undertaking runs in our favour: Section 1.8 obliges HDI to promote our Site and Products no less favourably than its own catalog titles, at HDI's cost. No provision requires us to extend best terms to HDI or to match third-party offers, so no redline is proposed.

input.quote: Each of HDI and the Company shall appoint a
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction. The only personnel provision (Section 5.4, General Managers) is a liaison mechanic and imposes no hiring restraint on us, which matches our preferred position of no non-solicit.
